name: Task List
description: The Task List is the central screen of MySimpleTodo — the first thing the user sees when opening the app. It shows all tasks at a glance, lets the user stay on top of their workload by filtering to a particular status or sorting by deadline, and provides direct actions on each task. It also serves as the launch point for creating new tasks.
entry_points: Opening the app in the browser (the default and only screen)
Returning here after saving or cancelling the Task Form
information_displayed: List of all tasks, each showing: title, due date, status badge, and overdue indicator when the due date has passed and the task status is not Done
Empty state ('No tasks yet.') when no tasks exist or none match the active filter
Loading state while tasks are being fetched from the backend
Error state if tasks fail to load

available_actions.description: Opens the Task Form in create mode to capture details for a new task.
Opens the Task Form pre-filled with the task's current values so the user can update them.
Shows a confirmation prompt; if the user confirms, permanently removes the task. Cannot be undone.
Updates a task's status inline (Todo / In Progress / Done) without opening the Task Form.
Narrows the visible task list to only tasks matching the selected status.
Sorts the task list ascending by due date (earliest first). Tasks without a due date appear last.

business_rules: All tasks are shown by default with no filter applied
When a filter is active, only tasks matching that status are shown
Tasks with a past due date are marked overdue only if their status is not Done; Done tasks never show the overdue indicator
When sorting by due date, tasks without a due date appear after those that have one
Deleting a task is permanent — no undo
Before a task is deleted, a confirmation prompt must be shown; the deletion only proceeds if the user confirms
Tasks are always sorted ascending by due date (earliest first) when sort is applied
Status can be changed directly from the list without opening the edit form
edge_cases: No tasks exist → empty state with an 'Add Task' prompt
Filter active but no tasks match → 'no results' message (not an error)
Backend fetch fails → error banner with a retry button
A 'Done' task with a past due date shows no overdue indicator
